name: izy-ai-venice
description: Izy AI Venice Chrome extension with OpenRouter support

scripts.build: echo 'Web app build complete - files ready for deployment'
scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let filePath = '.' + req.url; if (filePath === './') filePath = './index.html'; const extname = String(path.extname(filePath)).toLowerCase(); const mimeTypes = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json' }; const contentType = mimeTypes[extname] || 'application/octet-stream'; fs.readFile(filePath, (error, content) => { if (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') { res.writeHead(404); res.end('File not found'); } else { res.writeHead(500); res.end('Server error'); } } else { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': contentType }); res.end(content, 'utf-8'); } }); }); server.listen(8000, () => console.log('Server running at http://localhost:8000/'));"
scripts.dev: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let filePath = '.' + req.url; if (filePath === './') filePath = './index.html'; const extname = String(path.extname(filePath)).toLowerCase(); const mimeTypes = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json' }; const contentType = mimeTypes[extname] || 'application/octet-stream'; fs.readFile(filePath, (error, content) => { if (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') { res.writeHead(404); res.end('File not found'); } else { res.writeHead(500); res.end('Server error'); } } else { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': contentType }); res.end(content, 'utf-8'); } }); }); server.listen(8000, () => console.log('Server running at http://localhost:8000/'));"
